## Implemented

- The root Portable Report Flow exports read-only Snowflake baselines, validates integrity, materializes Snapshot Output Bundles, compares reports, and publishes bundle indexes.
- Report generation uses a thin adapter around existing report calculations; baseline paths and checksums are validated before use.
- Portable alert rendering consumes a supplied Alert Decision, produces deterministic facts and visuals, and keeps expected HTML optional and outside generation.
- The credential-free dry-run policy chain covers authoritative-feed parsing, identity reconciliation, Country Threat Assessment, Product Decision, lifecycle transitions, suppressed delivery attempts, and V1 Product Facts.
- V2 contract, canonicalization, synthetic-vector, frozen-V1, identity-retention, and independent root-verification readiness is implemented. Exact evidence belongs to the [Alert Product V2 Readiness Reference](../reference/alert-product-v2-readiness.qmd).

## Runtime Absent

- No ProductDecision v2 or ProductFactSet v2 producer runtime exists.
- No operational Storm Episode persistence or immutable link-event store exists.
- No V1-to-V2 runtime adapter, root ProductFactSet consumer, PresentationProfile renderer, or CompositionManifest producer exists.
- No root PublicationManifest v2 integration or HTML/PNG privacy enforcement exists.
- No operational persistence writer, scheduled ingestion, recipient outbox, provider delivery, real send, or legacy cutover is active.
- No Azure format-test job, shared alert-platform stack, subscription deployment, or delivery workload is provisioned.

## Active Planning

- The [Alert Packaging Consultation Pack](alert-packaging-consultation.qmd) implements four root-owned, non-normative email/report alternatives using minimized synthetic official Alert, official Warning, and forecast-only Warning evidence states.
- The [Azure Alert Execution Plan](azure-alert-execution-plan.qmd) proposes one coordinated Azure stack with separate format, subscription, and future delivery deployables. Its first stage is a manual synthetic-only format job with no recipient or send capability.
- The committee-reviewed Azure sequence now distinguishes a synthetic proof of concept, non-sending multi-Country-Office shadow pilot, controlled live-send pilot, and SLO/residency-driven regional production cells. Operational delivery-state Azure SQL, Service Bus Premium, provider feedback, suppression, and reconciliation belong only to the separately approved live-send stage; Stage B may use non-delivery SQL for comparison/checkpoints.
- The [Alert Subscription Service Plan](alert-subscription-service-plan.qmd) defines a proposed private, registration-only App Service with Entra workforce/B2B access. No service repository, Azure resources, recipient collection, opaque candidate/resolver Interface, or send path has been implemented.
- Deterministic offline generation, focused semantic and privacy checks, ignored HTML/QMD build output, and 24 provenance-bound desktop/mobile screenshots are implemented. Accountable stakeholder review and approval remain incomplete.
- The pack does not add PresentationProfile IDs or change Orchestration policy, V2 contracts, the compatibility renderer, publication approval, or delivery state.
- The draft root readiness integration must verify the exact current dependency heads before claiming cross-repository current-head coverage, then repin to default-branch-reachable commits after dependency merges.

## Blocked Activation

Operational activation remains blocked on forecast-identity stability evidence, content privacy inspection, source licensing, packaging consultation and its durable decision, Country Office and stakeholder approval, deployment monitoring, persistence/concurrency validation, delivery controls, and explicit accountable approval.

Readiness evidence is not runtime behavior, certification, publication approval, or permission to send.
